title: Measure drift in percentage points, and ask the client
objectives: Measure drift: current share minus target share.
body_md:
How to measure drift: current share of an asset class minus its target share. A 60% target now at 66% has drifted +6 points. Measure each goal's pot separately when goals have different mixes. Questions to ask the client: “Do you remember the mix we agreed, and why?” “Has anything changed in your goals, income or comfort with risk?” “Are you adding new money soon (SIPs, bonus, maturity)?” “Do you hold investments elsewhere that we should count?”

> **Investor takeaway:** A 60% target at 66% has drifted +6 points.
example: Target 60%, current 66% → drift +6 points. Same fund for two goals with different mixes? Measure each goal's pot separately.
say: Current share minus target share, in percentage points.
Measure each goal's pot separately when mixes differ.
